title: Chapter 257: Building A Zerg Base
content:
Chapter 257: Building A Zerg Base

The Zerg army has a limited number of troops dedicated to clearing underground bunkers, and the clearing speed is not fast. At the current speed, it will take a lot of time to clear the entire city's underground bunkers.

Wu Qing sent out the Zerg puppies who did not need to participate in the war for the time being, and conducted a careful search of the entire city from the ground. Combined with the underground bunkers detected by the Zerg host, he found the entrances and exits of all underground bunkers.

Wu Qing sent out heavy troops to block all the entrances and exits. He also changed the positions of 10,000 Zerg stealth spiders, and began to clear them underground from the direction close to the mountains.

After the Zerg Stealth Spider cleared a safe area near the city wall on the side of the mountain in City 66, the transport host flew over and dropped a large number of Zerg worker bees.

These Zerg worker bees have not been upgraded and are small in size. One transport host can carry a lot of them.

Wu Qing first upgraded these Zerg worker bees, and then ordered them to start digging underground.

The work efficiency of the high-star Zerg worker bees greatly increased, and a huge underground passage was soon dug downwards.

When the Zerg worker bees dug into the underground bunker space dug by the goblins, they did not stop. Instead, they continued to dig deeper and temporarily piled the excavated mud and rocks into the surrounding underground bunker space.

The Zerg worker bees kept digging downward until they reached a depth where even the five-star Zerg hosts in the air could not sense their situation. Then they stopped and began to dig the underground space at this depth.

The Zerg stealth spiders are constantly cleaning the underground bunker space in the city, and the Zerg worker bees are constantly expanding the space deep underground. The entire ground of City 66 seems a bit calm.

Occasionally there are interconnected underground bunkers, and they discover the terrifying attacks of the Zerg army underground. They want to rush out from the entrance and exit of the underground bunker. At the entrance and exit heavily guarded by the Zerg army, they will die as soon as they show up.

The entrances and exits of underground bunkers are limited in size. No matter how powerful the army is, they will be unable to function if they are blocked underground. They will only be trapped to death.

Even if there are races like Goblins who are good at digging in these armies, there will be no time to dig out new passages. As long as the Zerg host discovers that the alien human defenders in an underground bunker are trying to find a way out, the Zerg stealth spiders will give priority to them. .

In this way, the Zerg army blocked a large number of Tianwai human troops underground, and slowly cleared them step by step.

Observers from all parties basically have no ability to observe the fighting underground, and can only make some speculations about the situation underground.

"The defenders of the outer human race went underground to avoid the powerful attack of the Zerg army's ultra-long-range troops. Unexpectedly, they are now trapped in it!"

"They are probably waiting for the reinforcements from the Outer Worlds. It depends on whether the Outer Worlds can form a reinforcement force that can defeat the Zerg army in a short period of time!"

"There are units in the Zerg army that are good at going underground to attack. Those outer-world human defenders who have gone underground must be having a hard time now!"

"The situation in the city is quite complicated. We can no longer see some of the actions of the Zerg army!"

"In the underground battle, we can only wait for the final result. We want to see the process, but there is no other way!"

"..."

While observers from all forces were speculating about the underground battle, the Zerg worker bees had dug out a huge underground space deep underground near the mountain in City 66.

Several unupgraded Zerg worker bees crawled in, each at a certain distance, and used their bodies to build the Zerg mother nest.

A moment later, the first batch of Zerg mother nests were built outside the Zerg territory, and an invisible rule-level force was born. The location of the Zerg mother nests transcended the limitations of space and became part of the Zerg territory.

"Sure enough, a Zerg territory has been formed, and it is integrated with the original Zerg territory!"

"This will be much more convenient and save you the trouble of binding other territories!"

Wu Qing was very satisfied with the result. The distance in space did not affect the connection between the Zerg territories.

In other words, any time Wu Qing builds a Zerg base anywhere in the world, it will automatically become part of the Zerg territory and will not be subject to strange intrusions.

It doesn't matter whether the Zerg base is protected by other territorial cities.

Wu Qing hatched the larvae produced by several Zerg mother nests into Zerg worker bees, and upgraded the mother nests in order to obtain more larvae and speed up the dispatch of troops.

All the larvae hatch into Zerg worker bees, and the Zerg worker bees continue to build the Zerg mother nest. When enough Zerg mother hives are built in the entire underground space, the Zerg worker bees will be upgraded and join the team of underground space excavation and expansion.

With the Zerg Mother Hive, the soil, stones, minerals and other materials excavated by the Zerg worker bees are sent to the Zerg Mother Hive and converted into energy resources for the system.

Wu Qing asked the Zerg Queen to control the rapid development process of the Zerg base, so that the coordination of various Zerg units could reach perfection. In a short time, a huge Zerg underground base was built.

This Zerg underground base will be the focus of the Zerg's construction in the next period of time, and will be the core of the Zerg's dominance of the public battlefield in the southern theater.

Judging from Wu Qing's limited understanding of the Tianwai Human Race, this siege was a bit too easy. As the super powerful clan of the Evil God camp, the Tianwai Human Race could not possibly be at this level.

So after the Zerg base was built, Wu Qing did not rush to send troops to clear out the enemies in the underground bunkers in the city, but continued to expand the underground space, increase the number of Zerg nests, and continuously enhance the Zerg's war potential here.

The Zerg's development speed is extremely terrifying when resources are sufficient.

The number of Zerg worker bees has rapidly increased from hundreds at the beginning to thousands and tens of thousands. Now the number has exceeded 100,000, and the number is still increasing.

Except for the Zerg worker bees used to build the Zerg nest and some Zerg defense buildings, other Zerg worker bees have been upgraded.

Such a large number of star-level Zerg worker bees are digging all around, and the underground space is expanding at an astonishing speed.

Although the mineral resources in the underground of this area cannot be compared with the underground world occupied by the Zerg, they are very rich in the aboveground world. The earth and stone minerals excavated by the Zerg worker bees can convert a lot of system energy resources, which is enough to make up for part of the resource consumption of the rapid expansion of the Zerg base.

The sun rises and sets, and a day has passed.

It would take several days to clear all the underground bunkers in the city with only 10,000 Zerg stealth spiders.

During the construction of the Zerg base, the Naga tribe gave the Zerg a large number of luck beads as a thank you gift to thank the Zerg destroyers for their important role in the war.

Wu Qing immediately arranged to absorb and convert these luck beads into the system's gas resources, so that the system's gas resources, which were consumed in large quantities, became abundant again.

Wu Qing estimated that the news of the Naga tribe's victory over the Skeleton tribe had spread to the local camp, and everyone knew that the Zerg supported the Naga tribe's more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers.

In addition, the Zerg army was halfway through the siege, which was another good opportunity to trade Zerg energy coins with the goblins.

It was so cool to fleece these big tribes, and a lot of resources could be obtained every time.

Wu Qing sent a considerable number of Zerg energy coins to Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce in Mengzhong City, which directly indicated that the Zerg only wanted luck beads.

Gong Zhe looked at the boxes of Zerg energy coins and was so happy that he couldn't find his way. He readily agreed to Wu Qing's request.

In order to exchange Zerg energy coins with the Zerg, the Goblins had prepared enough luck beads. As soon as Gong Zhe's application was submitted, the luck beads were immediately delivered to the Zerg.

The money and goods were settled, and everyone was happy!

Another batch of luck beads was in hand, and Wu Qing was more confident!

...

After a day and a night of rapid development, the number of Zerg mother nests in the Zerg base underground in the 66th city has reached thousands, and the Zerg fungal blanket covers the entire underground space.

These Zerg mother nests are evenly distributed in the huge underground space. The star rating of the mother nests has been upgraded accordingly by the Queen according to the needs of development and planning.

The possibility of the existence of powerful enemies in the underground of this area is relatively small. The number of defensive buildings in the Zerg base is very small, and it is enough to maintain basic defense.

The Zerg base on this public battlefield is an offensive base. The continuous outward attack of the Zerg army is the best protection for the Zerg base.

This scale of Zerg base is enough to deal with possible situations for the time being, and the subsequent expansion of the Zerg base is not so urgent.

Wu Qing is ready to deal with the enemies in the underground bunkers in the city. He first hatched 40,000 Zerg Hydralisks, and then evolved them all into Zerg Stealth Spiders.

After upgrading these 40,000 Zerg Stealth Spiders to one-star, they were all sent out to cooperate with the original 10,000 high-star Zerg Stealth Spiders.

In the closed underground space, the armor-piercing ground spike attack of the one-star Zerg Stealth Spider is enough, and it is just right to cooperate with the high-star Zerg Stealth Spiders.

With the additional 40,000 one-star Zerg Stealth Spiders participating in the battle, the speed of the cleanup operation in the city can be increased several times.

The Zerg mother nest in the Zerg base cannot be idle, and Wu Qing began to hatch a large number of Zerg puppies.

A Zerg puppy only consumes 25 energy, and one larva can hatch two. This consumption is extremely insignificant for the current Zerg.

Although the unupgraded Zerg Zerglings are still ordinary soldiers, their combat power is already equivalent to that of one-star soldiers. With such conditions, the sea of Zerglings that Wu Qing wanted can finally be truly unveiled.

Zerg Zerglings soon filled the space of the Zerg base. They drilled into the ground in batches to make room for the Zerg Zerglings that hatched later.

In this orderly layered manner, there is no telling how many Zerg Zerglings are hidden under the Zerg base.
